items.item_text: 01. Do you possess a master's or doctoral degree from an accredited institution in Counseling Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, Professional Clinical Counseling, or a closely related behavioral health discipline? Options: Yes | No

02. Do you have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible experience providing mental health assessment, psychotherapy, crisis intervention, outreach, consultation, or related behavioral health services? Options: Yes | No

03. Are you currently licensed in California, or eligible to obtain California licensure, as a Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or Licensed Professional Clinical Counselor (LPCC)? Options: Yes | No
04. The anticipated hiring salary for this position is $76,500 annually. Does this meet your salary expectations? Options: Yes | No
05. o you have legal authorization to work in the United States? Options: Yes | No
